summary.text: Titus Nichols is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia House of Representatives, District 34, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Devan Seabaugh.
A trial attorney, small business owner and U.S. Army Reserve officer who lives in Marietta, he says he is running on housing costs, childcare costs and public schools.

paragraphs.text: Nichols was born in Aurora, Colorado, earned a high school diploma from Columbus Alternative High School, a bachelor's degree from Morehouse College in 2006 and a law degree from the University of Georgia School of Law in 2009.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as an attorney and business owner and as a captain in the U.S. Army, and says he has served as a Judge Advocate General in the Georgia Army National Guard.
It also lists affiliations with the State Bar of Georgia, the State Bar of South Carolina, Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc., and Leadership Cobb.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Nichols described himself as a trial attorney, small business owner and Major in the U.S. Army Reserve who built his own law firm and lives in Marietta with his wife and two daughters.
He said his key messages include opposing private equity purchases of single-family homes in Cobb County, addressing childcare costs, and supporting affordable housing and strong public schools.
